title: PolyProPicks Founder Correction
description: A durable record of a Founder or Architect correction so the same mistake is not repeated across sessions. Stage 1 persists and reads corrections; the Correction Ledger and its governance belong to Stage 2.

subject.description: Short label for what the correction is about.

applies_to.description: Repository paths, command ids or policy ids the correction governs.

cycle_id.description: The Evolution cycle that surfaced the correction, when there is one.

accepted.description: A correction written by an executor is always a proposal. Acceptance is a separate architect step.

x-invariants: accepted must be false — the writing executor never accepts its own correction.
A correction must name at least one artifact it applies to, otherwise it cannot be enforced later.
Corrections are append-only files under evolution/corrections/ and are readable without any chat context.
